li.header: FROM: Site Coordination\nTO: All occupants\nPRIORITY: Immediate
li.title: Orderly departure
li.body:
Transport will call at the east apron in three waves. Bring identification, one carried item each, and any medication you take daily. Do not bring equipment, samples, or anything that was issued to you.

Seating is by the list posted in the foyer. If your name is not on the list, speak to your supervisor, not to the pilots.

This is a precaution. Normal operations will resume.

li.header: Pencil, on the back of a seating list
li.title: Wave two
li.body:
They changed the order. Wave one was supposed to be the clinic and the children, and it was the managers and their files. I counted forty-one people on the apron when the second shuttle left with eleven seats empty.

The pilot said the manifest was locked. I believe him. I think everyone on that list believed it too, which is how it got that far.

I am going back for Dessa. If this note is the only thing left of me, it says: the east apron, the third wave, nobody came.

li.title: Wave three: cancelled
li.body:
Wave three cancelled at the operator's request. Reason code: none given. Fuel state nominal. Crew standing by.

Crew released at the end of the shift. Hangar doors left open for returning personnel.

The doors are no longer open.

li.header: FROM: Facilities\nTO: All staff\nRE: Item 4 on the agenda, again
li.title: The machine on the second floor
li.body: It has been brought to our attention that the machine on the second floor is "making a noise". It is a coffee machine. It makes a noise. Please stop submitting this as a safety concern.\n\nIt has also been brought to our attention that the noise is "words". Facilities has listened. It is not words.

li.header: FROM: Facilities\nTO: All staff\nRE: The machine on the second floor
li.title: It is words
li.body:
Apologies. It is a few words. The word is "yes", and it says it after the cup is empty and before anyone has touched a button. Facilities does not consider this a fault, as the coffee is of acceptable quality.

Please do not ask it questions. Three people have, and the answers were specific.

The machine will remain in service.

li.kind: Facilities memo, last of its folder
li.header: FROM: Facilities\nTO: Whoever is still here
li.title: Item 4
li.body:
I have unplugged the machine on the second floor and I want it on record that it made no objection, which is worse.

There are forty cups on the tray. I did not pour them.

If you find this, the kitchen has dried goods in the left cupboard. Take them. I never understood why it was kept so well stocked, and I do not want to find out.

li.title: Door cycling, corridor B
li.body:
02:14 corridor B door 3 opened. No badge read.
02:14 corridor B door 3 closed.
02:41 corridor B door 3 opened. No badge read.
02:41 corridor B door 3 closed.
03:08 corridor B door 3 opened. No badge read.

Occupancy sensors report zero persons in the corridor. Maintenance ticket raised. Door actuator reported healthy on three consecutive tests.

li.header: Building management, night cycle, three weeks later
li.title: Door cycling, whole level
li.body:
Door events now exceed the level's sensor capacity. Actuators healthy. Occupancy zero.

Pattern analysis: openings travel in a line, one door each twenty seconds, from the reactor stair towards the foyer. Speed consistent with a person walking. No person is present.

Pattern analysis note: the line has stopped at the foyer every night for twelve nights. Tonight it did not.

li.header: Building management, last entry before the gap
li.title: Occupancy: unresolved
li.body:
04:02 foyer door opened. Badge read: no badge.
04:02 occupancy sensors: 1.
04:03 occupancy sensors: 0.
04:03 occupancy sensors: 1.

Query: who is this? The system has no record of an employee by this description. The system has asked this question forty times. The system will keep asking.

[log continues after a gap of 11 years]
